title_en: First and foremost, there is a need for unity and agreement among the Pashtun nation to find a way to freedom from the yoke of slavery of the ruling nation, because the Pashtun nation is grappling with many problems due to the oppression and aggression of the ruling nation. The solution to this catastrophe for the Pashtun nation is a strong national uprising and unity, which, by the grace of God Almighty, will be the path to freedom from the chains of this dictatorial system. If we gather our brave Pashtuns together, it will be very easy to break the chains of this slavery. There is a need for an organized and purposeful struggle for the Pashtun nation to achieve its rights and independence, in which the participation of every Pashtun is necessary, and one must be ready for any sacrifice on the path of this struggle, because the future honor and independence of the Pashtun nation lies in the success of this struggle.

title: په پایله کې د پښتون قوم د پاره د دغه ډول یووالي او مبارزې د پاره د یوه داسې ملي مشرتابه اړتیا ده چې د پښتون قوم په درد پوه وي او د هغوی د ستونزو د حل لپاره ګامونه پورته کړي. زموږ دغه پښتانه چې په غرونو او دښتو کې ژوند کوي، د یوې داسې رهبرۍ محتاج دي چې هغوی د یوې روښانه راتلونکې په لور رهبري کړي. له همدې امله دغه ملي پاڅون نه یوازې د پښتون قوم د خلاصون لپاره، بلکې د ټولو مظلومو ولسونو لپاره یو مهم ګام دی. که چیرې موږ دغه فرصت له لاسه ورکړو، نو به بیا د پښتون قوم د ویښیدو او د یووالي لپاره هیڅ لاره پاتې نه شي. نو راځئ چې ټول یو موټی شو او د خپلې خاورې او خپل عزت د دفاع لپاره د یوې واحدې ملي اجنډا لاندې راټول شو، چې دغه زموږ د نیکمرغۍ او بریالیتوب لومړۍ زینه ده.
title_en: In conclusion, there is a need for a national leadership for such unity and struggle for the Pashtun nation, which understands the pain of the Pashtun nation and takes steps to solve their problems. Our Pashtuns, who live in mountains and deserts, need a leadership that will lead them towards a bright future. Therefore, this national uprising is an important step not only for the liberation of the Pashtun nation but also for all oppressed peoples. If we miss this opportunity, there will be no way left for the Pashtun nation to awaken and unite. So let us all unite and gather under a single national agenda for the defense of our land and our honor, which is the first step to our prosperity and success.
